finalText:
**Build's clean.** Exit 0, "0 errors."

Two real bugs from the bump, both were link-stage crashes hiding behind the noise:

- [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`.
- [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) treated an unset flag as invalid instead of `false`, since the new config loader leaves it `undefined`.

The rest were just deprecation/style warnings (`Buffer()`, `punycode`, unused export, circular import) — left those alone.

Next: nothing.
